limitations.limitation_text: PaySim is synthetic mobile-money fraud evidence. It is useful for a temporal proxy workflow, but it is not real-bank AML superiority evidence.
limitations.required_repair: Add a real financial-crime holdout or partner-approved private evaluation before making hard AML claims.

limitations.limitation_text: The Elliptic row is a supporting temporal graph-feature result. It does not prove graph-neural or graph-SOTA superiority.
limitations.required_repair: Run repeated-seed graph baselines and promote a graph-native candidate only if it beats strong feature baselines under the same split.

limitations.limitation_text: Elliptic2 is retained as modern context and limitation evidence only; it is not a Relaytic performance contribution in this paper.
limitations.required_repair: Reproduce a faithful RevClassify parity run or define a new leakage-resistant subgraph protocol with viable cohort proof.

limitations.limitation_text: Operational review-budget rows are supporting estimates because aggregate case packets, same-queue incumbent comparisons, and analyst-hour assumptions are not fully frozen.
limitations.required_repair: Freeze case-packet completeness and compare against the same review queue or an approved incumbent baseline.

limitations.limitation_text: The first draft is generated from committed evidence, but P12 must still prove clean-clone install, paper-smoke reproduction, leak scan, and claim lint.
limitations.required_repair: Run Paper Track P12 from a clean clone and record the external dry-run report before arXiv release.
